findings.description: Severe-dry-eye Phase 2: prose (§3.4) hedges NCT01393132 as a best-fit inference and gives 'n=9, 12 eyes treated', but the §3.9 trial table lists NCT01393132 as a firm n=9 row with no '(inferred)' marker, presenting an inference as settled fact when read in isolation. Annotate the table row as NCT-inferred.

In-text citations use per-section local bracket numbers (and a separate '-D' series in §7) while the shipped bibliography is a single unified deduped list [1]-[79]; no mechanical mapping is provided, so a reader cannot resolve e.g. §7.3 [4-D] -> unified [35]. Renumber to the unified scheme or add a per-section local->unified crosswalk.

Registered-trial arithmetic is soft: text asserts '~19 registered studies / 19 NCTs' with a breakdown summing to 19, but the §3.9 table enumerates ~21 distinct NCT rows (incl. the [62] cluster). The count is defensible but its components don't transparently reconcile to the table. State the counting rule so the number is auditable.

The pro-metastatic safety floor ('active/recent solid malignancy a contraindication') leans on a 2003 adenoviral OVER-EXPRESSION model [64]; the caveat that forced over-expression is a weaker proxy for exogenous peptide dosing is not made explicit. Adding it strengthens the report's honesty without changing the conservative conclusion.

The token '[19]' is overloaded: unified bibliography [19] is Kumar 2016 (Ac-SDKP cascade, grounds §2.4) but the cross-reference notation '= Section G [19]' attaches '19' to the Esposito identity paper, creating momentary ambiguity about which source grounds the Ac-SDKP claim. Disambiguate via the crosswalk.
